The '''Cal-serpent''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of predatory [[Snake/Legends|snakes]] native to [[Dra III]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Wyl sector/Legends|Wyl sector]]. Cal-serpents were sometimes hunted on safaris by off-planet, big-game [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cal-serpents were mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which was released in [[2009]].<ref name="TEA" />
